title: All About Moss
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds j, v, w
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 3, 29-sound stage. Simple true facts about hedgehogs, told through Moss.

pages.text: Moss has a lot of pins.
pages.illustration: Close view of Moss the hedgehog's brown back, covered all over in small spikes, in the long grass.
Moss the hedgehog with his nose down in a patch of dark mud at the edge of the long grass.

pages.text: Moss digs. Moss gets a bug.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog lifting his head up with a small dark beetle near his nose.
Moss the hedgehog curled into a tight ball, asleep inside a cosy pile of dry brown leaves.
Moss the hedgehog standing next to a much bigger grey rock in the long grass, to show his small size.
Moss the hedgehog mid-dig, front paws deep in the mud, a small pile of earth beside him.
Moss the hedgehog curled up asleep again in the leaf pile, in warm afternoon light.
Moss the hedgehog and Olive the grey owl sitting together on a log at the edge of the long grass.
